body:
Source: whole-repo bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2). `packages/gate-manifest/test/enable.test.mjs` and `segment-writer.test.mjs` contain 119 `try/finally` blocks and redundant local `gitRepo()`/`clean()` fixture helpers that manually manage tempdir cleanup. Following the introduction of `@adlc/core/test-kit` in #1098, both files can adopt `tmp(t)` and `gitRepo(t)` with automatic `t.after` lifecycle cleanup.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/gate-manifest/test/enable.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp, gitRepo }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Remove local `function gitRepo` and `function clean`.
   - Update test cases to pass `t` to `gitRepo(t, ...)` and `tmp(t, ...)`.
   - Remove all 63 `try { ... } finally { clean(root); }` blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In `packages/gate-manifest/test/segment-writer.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp, gitRepo }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Remove local `function gitRepo` and `function clean`.
   - Update test cases to pass `t` to `gitRepo(t, ...)` and `tmp(t, ...)`.
   - Remove all 56 `try { ... } finally { clean(root); }` blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/gate-manifest/test/enable.test.mjs'` from the ALLOWLIST array.
4. Ensure all gate-manifest and boundary tests pass: `npm test -w packages/gate-manifest` and `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' packages/gate-manifest/test/enable.test.mjs packages/gate-manifest/test/segment-writer.test.mjs` reports 0 for enable.test.mjs and 0 for segment-writer.test.mjs (down from 63 and 56).
- AC2 Neither file defines local `function clean` or local `function gitRepo`.
- AC3 `grep -n 'packages/gate-manifest/test/enable.test.mjs' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/gate-manifest` exits 0 with all test cases passing.
- AC5 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` and `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exit 0.
title: refactor(gate-manifest): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 119 try/finally cleanup blocks in enable and segment-writer tests
